about: Lloydminster (Alberta part) is the Alberta side of the border city of Lloydminster, which straddles the Alberta–Saskatchewan boundary on the Yellowhead Highway. Only the portion west of Meridian Avenue / the provincial line is this census subdivision; the Saskatchewan side is counted separately. Oilfield services, retail, and prairie streets continue across the border as one urban area. About 20,000 people live in the Alberta part of Lloydminster.
seoSummary: Alberta side of the Alberta–Saskatchewan border city of Lloydminster—oilfield hub west of the meridian line, not the Saskatchewan half.
